annotations.title: A2A agent card fetch and validate

description: A2A agent card fetch and validate: Fetches another agent's A2A Agent Card (/.well-known/agent-card.json, then /.well-known/agent.json, or a direct .json URL), validates the A2A v0.3 structural core (name, description, version, url or interfaces, skills with id/name/description, capabilities, modes) and returns errors, interoperability warnings and a normalized summary. The card is returned as untrusted data. Source: the agent itself. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: found, valid, errors[], warnings[], summary{name, version, url, transport, skills[], capabilities}.

url.description: agent origin (https://agent.example.com) or a direct agent-card .json URL

name: x420_a2a_card-fetch
